digest.component_or_area: Source code comment quality / CI lint gate
propositions: Source code comments contain unresolvable commit SHAs, run/job/thread IDs, and dated incident narratives that rot as retention windows expire and rebases invalidate references.

A detector must identify rot-prone patterns (SHA-like hex ≥7 chars, run/job/thread IDs ≥8 digits, date+incident-verb blocks) and reject them unless cited by a durable ticket/epic/story/bug ID or escaped with 'context: external'.
All detector-hit sites in the codebase must be remediated by citing a ticket ID, removing the rot-prone token, or replacing SHA narratives with behavioral descriptions findable via git log.
A CI guard implementing the detector must pass the remediated tree with zero in-tree suppressions and fail on reintroduced violations, wired as a step in the build-and-test workflow.

The detector's own unit-test module must be structurally excluded from tree scans and contain live rot-prone tokens in fixtures to test FP gotchas ('bug surfaced', path-context aliases must not accept).
Policy guidance must document that source comments own current state and rationale while tickets own historical detail.
